[[File:Humidify icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Humidify''' is a [[Lunar spell]] that requires 68 [[Magic]] plus the quests [[Dream Mentor]] and [[Lunar Diplomacy]] to be cast. This spell will fill all empty water-carrying vessels in a player's inventory with a single cast including: [[bucket]]s, [[fishbowl]]s, [[jug]]s, [[vial]]s, [[watering can]]s (including [[Gricoller's can]]), unwatered [[sapling]]s, [[waterskin]]s, [[bowl]]s, and [[clay]]. 
It yields 65 [[experience]] per cast regardless of the number of vessels filled. It can also be used to extinguish the wall of flames in the [[Chambers of Xeric]] when fighting [[Great Olm]] or to refill waterskins in the [[Kharidian Desert]] instead of needing to cut [[Kharidian cactus|cacti]].

A [[steam battlestaff]], [[twinflame staff]], or [[staff of water]] and [[tome of fire]] or [[staff of fire|vice]] [[tome of water|versa]] can be used for maximum efficiency. It can be used to train [[Magic]] while making profit from some of the items below:

To maximise experience per hour with this spell, put a [[fishbowl]] underneath the spell (similar to High Level Alchemy) and to the "F1" and "F6" keys (or custom F-keys) to switch between spellbook and inventory. Left-click empties the fishbowl. Casting High Level Alchemy is always cheaper when alchemising profitable items while this method always results in loss. Upon hearing the sound effect, all vessels have been filled.

Casting this spell while holding an empty waterskin in the desert is a requirement for the [[Hard Desert Diary|hard Desert diary]].

==Money making==
{{Mmgsection|Humidifying clay}}

==Saplings==

Because it is time consuming and gives little to no experience, planting tree seeds in [[filled plant pot]]s to grow saplings is often skipped in favour of buying the saplings directly from the [[Grand Exchange]]. This opens up an opportunity to grow saplings for profit. Like all methods involving large amounts of buying and selling, which require a relatively high capital to start, it is recommended to test the market by growing one sapling first to make sure it is profitable.

To plant the seeds in the pots, use one of them on the other with a [[gardening trowel]] in your inventory. This produces a [[seedling]]. When all the plant pots are filled with seeds, cast [[Humidify]] to water them. These watered seedlings will take approximately five minutes to turn into saplings, but this will happen even when [[bank]]ed. Repeating this process quickly will make around 1,700 saplings an hour.

Please note that tree seeds have a relatively low [[Grand Exchange#Buying limit|buying limit]], so you may want to stock up on them beforehand, or grow several different trees at once.
